observations.body: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Saul again enters the wilderness with chosen men to seek David.
observations.label: Pursuit repeats in Ziph

observations.body: Saul returns with chosen men while David observes the camp before acting.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 26:1–5 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The setting repeats an earlier danger even after Saul previously acknowledged David’s restraint.
payload.title: Another pursuit in Ziph
